prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: background illustration for a children's gentle fantasy adventure village mobile game home screen. Portrait 1024x1536. A welcoming small woodland village at blue twilight, warm lanterns, rounded little timber cottages, a winding turquoise stream, stone footpaths, distant floating islands and stars. Three distinct charming cottages in middle and lower portions: a gift cottage with a gold star on roof, a companion cottage with a shield emblem, and a cozy parent cottage with warm windows. A little expedition signpost and rolled map at village entrance. Painterly polished 2D storybook game art, deep teal and navy with amber windows, calm and safe, rich detail but clear silhouettes. Broad atmospheric dark sky in upper quarter for app title overlay. No people, no characters, no readable text, no letters, no UI, no logos, no watermark. This is decorative background; interactive labeled cards are separately rendered by app.
